sections.title: Situation, language and purpose
body: Goal: Interpret Swedish listening-task instructions and use a timed first-listen strategy on original material.

Core vocabulary: sammanfatta, alternativ, anteckna. Key phrases: Lyssna på meddelandet två gånger. · Välj det alternativ som bäst sammanfattar innehållet. · Anteckna bara de detaljer som frågan kräver.
Meaning first: use the language to complete a real task-instruction literacy for listening purpose, not to display isolated grammar.
Purposeful return: Repeat the task after a day with audio only and compare listening evidence, not memory of the transcript.

assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “What happens to Friday morning's water aerobics?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Give a brief oral summary of the swimming-hall message without repeating every detail. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Write structured listening notes and one complete answer from the audio. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: A second original announcement changes two times; separate the main change from the supporting detail.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Repeat the task after a day with audio only and compare listening evidence, not memory of the transcript.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Motionsbassängen öppnar senare på fredag på grund av underhåll. Vattengymnastiken flyttas till lördag klockan nio, och den gamla bokningen gäller automatiskt.

WRITING MODEL: Ändring: motionsbassängen öppnar fredag klockan 12. Orsak: underhåll. Vattengymnastik: lördag klockan 9. Åtgärd: ingen ny bokning behövs.
